title: Privacy policy
seoDescription: Privacy policy of Instal Berrozpe S.L. for enquiries received by form, email, phone or WhatsApp.
intro: This policy explains how Instal Berrozpe S.L. processes personal data received through this website and its contact channels.

sections.heading: Data controller
body: Legal and tax address: Antiga, 68, ground floor, Blanes. Public address: Carrer de l'Antiga, 68, 17300 Blanes, Girona, Spain.

sections.heading: Purpose and legal basis
body: Details you provide (name, email, optional phone number, service and message) are used to answer enquiries and handle quote requests.

When you request a quote or information about a potential service, the legal basis is taking pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)). For general enquiries, the basis is Instal Berrozpe S.L.'s legitimate interest in responding to communications (Article 6(1)(f)). You do not have to accept this policy to submit the form.
The data is not used for advertising and is not sold to third parties.

sections.heading: Service providers, recipients and transfers
body: The website and the function that processes the form are hosted by Vercel, Inc. Resend, Inc. delivers the message as a transactional email service; it is then received in the company mailbox managed with Google Workspace. These providers process data for the stated functions.

Resend states that email data and logs are stored in the United States and retained for 30 days while the account is active. Vercel may process data in the United States and other locations where it and its subprocessors operate. Google Workspace processes email according to the organisation's configuration.

International transfers, where they occur, must be covered by the data protection mechanisms and agreements in force with each provider, including Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable. The company should maintain those agreements and review each provider's subprocessor list.

sections.heading: Retention
body: Messages received in Google Workspace remain until they are manually deleted; no automatic deletion rule is currently configured. This does not replace applicable legal retention periods.

sections.heading: Your rights and complaints
body: Where applicable, you may request access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and data portability by writing to david@instalberrozpe.com.
You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) at https://www.aepd.es/.

pendingReviewNote: Check in the Admin console whether the Google Workspace data-processing terms have been accepted and review subprocessors before closing the review.
